name: RFID Emulation & Replay
description: After cloning a target credential, the data must be replayed at the access control reader. Emulation devices store the captured credential and present it electronically, simulating the target card. The Chameleon Ultra is purpose-built for this, can store multiple credentials, and can be configured to emulate specific card types. The RFID bracelet is a low-profile wearable option for hands-free proximity-based replay during social engineering approaches.

blue.det: Cloned credential used at unusual time or location; anti-passback violation; simultaneous use of same credential at different readers.
blue.cm: Anti-passback rules; credential geofencing; OSDP encrypted readers preventing credential replay; monitor for simultaneous credential use.
